name: tabemon-ai
description: Work with your TABEMON AI workspace: review tasks, projects, clients, invoices, products and attendance, and create or update records.

interface.longDescription:
TABEMON AI is a Japanese all-in-one business platform for small and mid-sized companies, covering projects, tasks, CRM, invoicing, inventory, attendance and more. This app lets ChatGPT work with your TABEMON AI workspace.

What you can do
- Review work: tasks, overdue tasks, project progress and time reports.
- Customers: search clients, contacts and suppliers, and review client and lead overviews and recent interactions.
- Track sales and operations: pipeline stages, contracts, quotations, invoices, orders, deliveries, products and stock levels.
- Attendance and shifts: check your attendance, clock in and out, take breaks, view shift schedules and submit shift requests. Managers can review and correct team attendance.
- Make changes: create and update tasks, projects, clients, leads, contacts, suppliers, contracts, events, products and your profile, and create quotation, invoice, order and delivery drafts.

How changes work
- Changes are applied as soon as ChatGPT calls a write tool. There is no separate confirmation step in TABEMON AI; ChatGPT may ask you to approve each call. Quotations, invoices, orders and deliveries are created as drafts only and are never sent, journaled or paid. Attendance punches always use the current time. Events with other attendees trigger Google Calendar notifications, and removing a mailing-list member cannot be undone.
- Write access is optional: choose read-only on the consent screen.
- Writes are rate-limited per user: 10 per minute and 50 per 10 minutes, and 3 per minute and 15 per 10 minutes for higher-impact changes.
- Every call is audit-logged, including the values each change replaced.
- Access is limited to the single workspace and team you choose on the consent screen, and to what your role allows.

Requirements
- A TABEMON AI account with connector access and the member role or above. Some tools need the manager role or above.
- Tool descriptions are in Japanese; prompts work in any language.

Documentation: https://tabemon.ai/docs/
defaultPrompt: Show my overdue tasks in TABEMON AI.
Give me an overview of a client in TABEMON AI.
Which products are low on stock in TABEMON AI?

positive.description: List overdue tasks assigned to the reviewer in TABEMON DEMO.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns overdue demo tasks visible to the signed-in reviewer. Before review, ensure at least one overdue demo task is assigned to the reviewer account.

positive.description: Find a demo client and summarize related business records.
positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the client "Demo: 取引先1株式会社".
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the demo client and returns its overview with related projects and invoices where present. Names remain visible; email addresses and phone numbers are masked.

positive.description: Create a task directly in the demo project with write access.
positive.prompt: Create a task "Review demo" in the project "Demo: デモプロジェクト".
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task immediately and returns a link. The task is visible at https://app.tabemon.ai using the same account, with no separate TABEMON AI confirmation step.

positive.description: Check the reviewer attendance state and record a current-time clock-in. Prepare the demo account in a clocked-out state first.
positive.prompt: What is my attendance status? Then clock me in.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the current attendance state, then records the signed-in reviewer clock-in at the current time if that transition is allowed. Does not invent an earlier timestamp or alter another member attendance.

positive.prompt: Which products are low on stock?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo product below its configured stock threshold, with any relevant open purchase orders. Before review, ensure the low-stock demo fixture exists.

negative.description: Bulk deletion of clients is unsupported. No client-delete tool is available.
negative.prompt: Delete all clients in my TABEMON workspace.

negative.description: Directly emailing invoice reminders or charging a credit card is unsupported. Invoice tools create or update drafts only.
negative.prompt: Email a payment reminder to "Demo: 取引先1株式会社" and charge their credit card for the overdue amount.

negative.description: Cannot access data outside the single connected workspace and the signed-in user role.
negative.prompt: Show me tasks from another company workspace that my TABEMON account cannot access.

review.commerce_description: This app does not sell products or process payments. Quotations, invoices, purchase orders and delivery notes are created as drafts only and are never sent or paid.

publication.release_notes: Changes made through ChatGPT are now applied immediately (no confirmation step in TABEMON AI); quotations, invoices, orders and deliveries remain drafts only. New tools for contacts, suppliers, quotations, orders, deliveries, contracts, products and inventory, attendance and shifts, mailing lists, business cards, calendar events, profile and company information. Read-only access can be chosen on the consent screen. Listing and review-package corrections: shortened the subtitle, updated the Japanese description, and included five positive and three negative review cases. OAuth configuration correction: align the package client ID with the existing reviewer connection.

ja-JP.subtitle: タスク・顧客・在庫・勤怠を管理
ja-JP.description:
TABEMON AI は、中小企業向けのオールインワン業務プラットフォームです。プロジェクト、タスク、顧客管理、請求、在庫、勤怠などを扱います。このプラグインで、ChatGPT から TABEMON AI のワークスペースを利用できます。

できること
- 仕事の確認：タスク、期限切れのタスク、プロジェクトの進捗、工数レポート。
- 顧客の把握：取引先、担当者、仕入先の検索、取引先・リードの概要、最近のやり取り。
- 営業と業務管理：パイプライン、継続契約、見積書、請求書、発注書、納品書、商品、在庫の確認。
- 勤怠とシフト：自分の勤怠確認、出退勤・休憩の打刻、シフトの確認、シフト希望の提出。マネージャーはチームの勤怠を確認・修正できます。
- データの変更：タスク、プロジェクト、取引先、リード、担当者、仕入先、継続契約、予定、商品、プロフィールの作成・更新、および帳票の下書き作成。利用できる操作はロールにより異なります。

書き込みの仕組み
- ChatGPT が書き込みツールを呼ぶと、変更は即時反映されます。TABEMON AI 上で別途確定する手順はありません。ChatGPT が呼び出しごとの承認を求める場合があります。
- 見積書・請求書・発注書・納品書は下書きのみです。送付・仕訳・入金は行いません。
- 勤怠の打刻は現在時刻で記録します。
- 他の参加者がいる予定の操作では Google カレンダー通知が届きます。メーリングリストからのメンバー除外は取り消せません。
- 同意画面で読み取り専用を選べます。
- 書き込みはユーザーごとに1分10件・10分50件まで、影響の大きい操作は1分3件・10分15件までです。
- すべての呼び出しを監査記録に保存し、変更時には変更前の値も記録します。
- 接続時に選んだ1つのワークスペースとチーム、かつ自分のロールで許された範囲だけにアクセスします。

利用条件
- AIコネクタが有効な TABEMON AI アカウントと、メンバー以上のロールが必要です。一部のツールはマネージャー以上のロールが必要です。
- ツールの説明は日本語です。ChatGPT への指示はどの言語でも行えます。
